subject: Backdrop grade + plane generation is unscripted: the luminance-weighted cyan grade and the pre-blurred far/near planes that produced _app/assets/images/backdrops/cloud-master*.webp ran in a one-off heredoc and exist nowhere in the repo. gen_backdrop.py is explicitly multi-house (--only <slug>), so the next backdrop has nothing to reuse and no guard against double-grading an already-graded file. (Nancy, on 6513b3ced)
